_note: Rules are data. tier: hard = refuse the option; soft = allowed, priced and shown; proposed = ours, always labelled as a proposal. Tiers are OUR reading of the rulebook; ES has not confirmed them. Change a tier here and nothing else.

rules.title: Car approved for every country on the route
rules.cite: §3: RDC none, they may run everywhere · GFF car 309 may not run to Italy; the BDCM type may not run to France · EuroExpress may not run to Italy. 'Hard to change, so treat them as fixed.'

rules.title: Train length within platform limits
rules.cite: §5: 16 cars in Germany, 15 in Belgium, and 13 in Switzerland, Italy and France. Paris and Prague can change length on the route by exchanging cars at the workshop; Milan cannot.

rules.title: One car, one train, one night
rules.cite: README M3: 'the same car planned twice'. A physical car cannot be in two trains.

rules.title: No shunting with passengers on board
rules.cite: §5: Cars with passengers on board cannot be shunted. Changes on the route happen at night with empty cars.

rules.title: A usable door on each side at both ends of the train
rules.cite: §5: A sleeper car cannot stand directly behind the locomotive, or at the end of the train, with its doors at the wrong end.

params.needs: door_end per car; UNKNOWN when the order sheet does not give it

rules.title: A car without high voltage runs empty at the back
rules.cite: §5: A car without high voltage breaks the power connection to the cars behind it. It can only run empty at the back, and not on a run where the locomotive changes sides.

rules.title: The physical car matches the product sold on its car number
rules.cite: §3/§4: sleeper UIC cars are always Comfort Plus; Bim(d)z is always seating; a booked number is tied to its product.

rules.title: 2 Comfort Plus, 2 Comfort Standard, 1 seating car per train
rules.cite: §3: Every train sells 2 Comfort Plus cars and 2 Comfort Standard cars and mostly 1 seating car, the rest is Classic couchettes.

rules.title: Second conductor from 9 occupied cars
rules.cite: §12 and Legend 'max 8 with clients (1 conductor confirmed)'.

rules.title: No drop or collection at a workshop over the weekend
rules.cite: §7: Workshops are closed at the weekend. Collected Friday evening at the latest; dropped Sunday to Thursday night. Graffiti risk.

rules.title: A Comfort Standard (mattress) car stays in its train
rules.cite: §3: Mattress cars stay put… a Comfort Standard car effectively stays in its train.

rules.title: Workshop check every 55,000 to 60,000 km
rules.cite: §7. No odometer exists in any provided file, so this rule always returns UNKNOWN.

rules.title: PROPOSAL: early warning when a car is marked not usable / pay attention 3+ times in 10 days
rules.cite: Ours. Not ES policy. Computed from the cell fills in the fleet grid.

rules.title: PROPOSAL: warn when a train-night has no approved reserve car of the same product
rules.cite: Ours. Not ES policy. Computed from code X / parked cars and the approval table.
